newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm as volume shrinks.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm as volume shrinks.

text.p: Traded volume continued to shrink on Istanbul's gold exchange due to slack free market demand on Friday, but prices firmed in line with the European trend, dealers said.
Volume was lower at 468 kilos after Thursday's 572 and was sharply below Monday's weekly high of 1,376 kilos.
Gold closed at 1,104,000 lira per gram and $383.25 an ounce, 7,750 lira and $0.3 higher from Thursday.
Dealers said a weak lira also fuelled gold prices in lira terms.
Activity which had livened up during the summer due to an increase in public and tourist demand for gold jewellery and coins recently began to fade as the season began to wind down.
Traded volume dropped to 115 kilos in the second session from 353 kilos in the morning. 64 percent of the total trade was in lira terms due to the lira's weakness.
